question: I bought refurbished EB-20 earbuds 9 days ago. Can I still return them?

trace.prompt:
You are TechNova's support assistant. Answer the customer using the help center context below.

Help center context:
[eb20#returns]
EB-20 Earbuds: Returns and warranty

You can return EB-20 earbuds within 15 days of delivery for a full refund. Because earbuds go in your ears, they must come back with every ear tip size and the charging case, and the ear tips must be clean. Start the return from the Orders page.

EB-20 earbuds are covered by TechNova's 1-year limited warranty. If one earbud loses sound or the case stops charging, you can make a warranty claim from your order.

Lost earbuds and lost charging cases aren't covered, but single replacement earbuds can be ordered from support at a reduced price.

[returns-policy#opened]
Returns Policy: Opened and used items

Opened products can be returned within the same window if they're undamaged and complete. Headphones and earbuds must include every ear tip and cushion they came with. For hygiene reasons, earbuds with missing ear tips can't be accepted.

Opened electronics have a 10 percent restocking fee, which is taken from your refund. Unopened products in sealed packaging are refunded in full.

If an opened product arrives back damaged, scratched, or with parts missing, we may send it back to you or offer a partial refund. Our team will email you photos and an explanation before deciding.

[warranty#coverage]
Limited Warranty: What the warranty covers

TechNova headphones, earbuds, and speakers come with a 1-year limited warranty from the date of delivery. It covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal use, for example a WH-1000 that stops charging, an earbud that loses sound, or a speaker with a failed driver.

The warranty doesn't cover accidental damage such as drops or liquid damage, normal wear such as worn cushions or scratches, or damage from unauthorized repairs.

If we confirm a defect, we'll repair or replace the product at no cost. A replacement is covered for the rest of the original warranty, or 90 days, whichever is longer.

Customer: I bought refurbished EB-20 earbuds 9 days ago. Can I still return them?

answer: Yes, you have 15 days from delivery, so you can still return them. Include every ear tip size and the charging case.
support_note: Return declined 9 days after delivery. The earbuds were refurbished and bought from the TechNova Outlet. The customer was told they had 15 days.
